description: SRP-01: FaviconResolver handles URL sanitization, extraction orchestration, fallback chain (standard paths → Google → DuckDuckGo), cache coordination, placeholder generation, and URL building. Extract: (1) fallback chain to FallbackChain class, (2) placeholder generation to PlaceholderHandler (also absorbs DRY-03). Resolver becomes thin orchestrator: extract → pick best → fetch → fallback.
